Post Kedua is literally means a second post in bahasa, in this post i want to share what i’ve learned about markdown, using hashtag give me a big size of letters which people used for title.
big title medium title small title 1st Paragraph.
2nd Paragraph.
using double star creates bold, using one star on each start and end give me italic, and double curly dash gives me strikethrough word.
List use dash:
list1 list2 list3 ordered list with number:
list1 list2 list3 Link using bracket: My Github
images: inline code: this is code or command
code block:
std::cout << "c++\n"; notes using this
title: Post Kedua
